name: Conjure Elemental
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You call forth an elemental servant. For every two mana you spent casting this spell, you may uncheck a Condition.

For each Condition you unchecked, the elemental gains 10 Endurance, 5 Defense, 2 ft of height, 100 lbs of weight, 10 ft of Speed, a d6 engagement die and unarmed melee attacks it makes deal an additional 1d6 damage.

Choose a mana color to determine the nature of the elemental (it must be a color you spent to cast this spell):

  • White: The elemental can fly and gains an additional d6 engagement die.

  • Blue: Once per round, the elemental may spend a reaction to re-roll one die roll it makes or force a creature within short range of it to re-roll one die.

  • Black: The elemental's Stealth checks are favored. Any time the elemental hits a creature with an attack for the first time, the creature checks a Condition.

  • Red: The elemental's melee attacks deal +1d damage. Anything flammable that touches the elemental ignites.

  • Green: The elemental gains +5 Defense and its weight doubles.

The elemental is friendly to you and your allies. It rolls its own initiative and takes its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it. If you don’t issue any commands to the elemental, it defends itself from hostile creatures but otherwise takes no actions.

Describe the elemental.
